recipes.name: Basic Burger
recipes.desc: The burger every newcomer to Morph City is legally required to try once. Bun, beef, pickle, lettuce, ketchup — so normal it is practically suspicious.
steps: Shred ING_LETTUCE, then slice ING_PICKLE into 3 coins (4 taps each).
Sear ING_BEEF_PATTY; flip once when it squeaks.
ING_BUN heel, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_PICKLE, ING_LETTUCE, ING_KETCHUP, ING_BUN crown.
cx: Is this... just a burger? Where's the twist?
My lettuce looks as tired as I feel.
recipes.look: Chunky 5-layer stack: tan dome bun with white sesame studs, brown puck patty, three green pickle coins, zig-zag lettuce frill, glossy ketchup drip.
recipes.anim: Patty squeaks and hops 0.2 studs at the flip cue; the plated burger idles with a tiny bounce (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Small square grill sparks, one steam puff when plated.
recipes.mut: The tutorial dish (`QST_TUT_003`): `MUT_145` Octopus Arm, the Chef tutorial pick, lets a brand-new cook chop while the patty grills.

recipes.name: Cheeseburger
recipes.desc: A Basic Burger that discovered cheese and never looked back. The cheese square is contractually obliged to hang off one corner.
steps: Slice ING_TOMATO into rounds, shred ING_LETTUCE.
Grill ING_BEEF_PATTY; flip at the chime.
ING_BUN heel, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_CHEESE draped while hot, ING_TOMATO, ING_LETTUCE, ING_KETCHUP, ING_BUN crown.
Plate with the droopy cheese corner facing the customer.
cx: The cheese isn't hanging off the corner. Is it even trying?
I asked for a CHEESEburger, not a cheese suggestion.
recipes.look: Classic stack with a bright yellow cheese square melted into a single dramatic drip over one edge.
recipes.anim: Cheese corner sags in a slow 0.5 s droop when placed on the hot patty (prop morph).
recipes.vfx: A tiny golden 'melt' sparkle as the cheese lands on the patty.
recipes.mut: `MUT_171` Oven Mitt Hands (fire) shave grill time; `MUT_102` Chef Hat Crest (chef) widens the patty's Perfect window.

recipes.name: Double Cheeseburger
recipes.desc: Two patties, two cheeses, one bun pretending it can handle the pressure. Structural engineers have been consulted.
steps: Grill both ING_BEEF_PATTY pucks side by side (both slots); flip each in its window.
ING_BUN heel, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_CHEESE, ING_LETTUCE, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_CHEESE, ING_KETCHUP, ING_BUN crown.
cx: One of these patties is clearly the favourite child.
It leaned. It LEANED at me.
recipes.look: Tall 8-layer stack with two cheese drips on opposite sides, slightly tilted like it's thinking.
recipes.anim: Stack wobbles left-right once when set down, then settles (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Double sizzle sparks on the grill; a crumb puff when the crown bun lands.
recipes.mut: `MUT_156` Spatula Arm (chef) widens both patties' windows; `ABL_061` Extra Hands lets you build the stack while both patties finish.

recipes.name: Triple Stack Burger
recipes.desc: Three patties stacked so high the top bun files its own weather report. Eat from the top down, or call a ladder.
steps: Round 2: grill the third ING_BEEF_PATTY while you start the stack.
ING_BUN heel, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_CHEESE, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_CHEESE, ING_PICKLE, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_CHEESE, ING_KETCHUP, ING_BUN crown.
Plate and stab a toothpick flag through the top.
cx: The middle patty is lonely. You can tell.
I need a step stool to start this.
recipes.look: A 10-layer tower about 1.5 studs tall with a tiny toothpick flag reading 'TRIPLE' on top.
recipes.anim: Customer uses ANM_043 Eat with a stretched jaw (morph-scale 1.4) on the first bite; the tower sways while carried.
recipes.vfx: Toothpick flag flutters; three-part cheese drip shimmer.
recipes.mut: `MUT_249` Extra Arm Backpack (`ABL_061`) is the triple-stack enabler: grill round 2 while stacking round 1. Carry-boosting parts keep it upright.

recipes.name: Bacon Monster Burger
recipes.desc: Four crispy bacon strips arranged as monster fangs around a BBQ-glazed patty. It growls when you set it down. It's the bun settling. Probably.
steps: Fry four ING_BACON strips crisp; shake once.
ING_BUN heel, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_BBQ_SAUCE, ING_CHEESE, ING_BACON fangs poking out, ING_BUN crown.
Plate with the fangs facing out.
cx: My burger had fewer fangs than advertised. I count THREE.
It's supposed to look scary. It looks shy.
recipes.look: Burger with four bacon strips curled out like fangs and two olive-sized cheese 'eyes' melted on the crown bun.
recipes.anim: Bacon fangs flex open-shut once on plating (prop bone), timed to a cartoon growl.
recipes.vfx: Small brown grease-free 'crisp' sparkles; a comic growl text bubble 'grr'.
recipes.mut: Fire-tagged parts (e.g. `MUT_163` Lava Fist Arm) shave fryer and grill time; `MUT_120` Cow Body chefs get a 'no comment' bark from the patty.

recipes.name: Pickle Mountain Burger
recipes.desc: A burger buried under a landslide of twelve pickle coins. Mountaineers have planted three flags on it. Two were pickles.
steps: Slice four ING_PICKLE spears into 12 coins.
ING_BUN heel, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_CHEESE, ING_MUSTARD, ING_PICKLE mountain, ING_BUN crown balanced on top.
Plate; any pickle that rolls off must go back on the summit.
cx: This is a pickle HILL at best.
Exactly how many pickles is a mountain? Not THIS many.
recipes.look: A cone of 12 green pickle coins piled between patty and a bun crown perched at a jaunty angle.
recipes.anim: One pickle coin rolls off and back on (prop physics-free tween) when served.
recipes.vfx: Green sparkle 'brine twinkle' around the pile; tiny flag icon on top.
recipes.mut: `MUT_058` Truffle Pig Super-Snout (`ABL_064`) reveals hidden COUNT mods ('exactly seventeen pickles') before you chop.

recipes.name: Volcano Burger
recipes.desc: Grilled Lava Peppers erupt from a cheese caldera while hot sauce flows down the bun like a tiny, delicious disaster movie.
steps: Blister two ING_LAVA_PEPPER on the second slot (no flip).
ING_BUN heel, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_CHEESE crater, ING_LAVA_PEPPER, ING_JALAPENO, ING_HOT_SAUCE lava flow, ING_BUN crown.
Plate and let the sauce 'erupt' down one side.
cx: Where's the eruption? I was promised geology.
Too hot! I mean — not hot ENOUGH! I mean — WATER!
recipes.look: Bun crown with a crater hole; orange-red peppers poke out the top and a glossy red sauce flow runs down one side.
recipes.anim: Peppers puff a smoke ring on plating; customer plays ANM_043 then a cartoon fan-face (steam ears).
recipes.vfx: Cartoon steam puffs and orange 'heat shimmer' sprites (no flames on characters).
recipes.mut: `MUT_254` Fireproof Skin and `MUT_034` Lava Rock Head (fire) shave both grill steps; `MUT_273` Flame Aura chefs get a 'hot hands' sparkle.

recipes.name: Frozen Burger
recipes.desc: Grilled to perfection, then frozen solid, then topped with ice. Served with a straw and a sense of betrayal. Yeti-Fish adore it.
steps: Grill ING_BEEF_PATTY first — it must be cooked before it's frozen.
Freeze ING_BEEF_PATTY with ING_CHEESE on top (8 s) until frosty.
ING_BUN heel, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_CHEESE, ING_LETTUCE, ING_ICE cubes, ING_WHIPPED_CREAM snowcap, ING_BUN crown.
Plate on a frosty plate; serve before the snowcap slumps.
cx: It's not frozen, it's 'mildly chilly'. Unacceptable.
My teeth are cold and my heart is colder.
recipes.look: Burger glazed in pale blue frost with ice-cube 'toppings' and a whipped-cream snowcap.
recipes.anim: Customer taps the burger with a fork (ANM_043 variant), it clinks; frost cracks off in flakes.
recipes.vfx: Drifting snowflake particles and a cold-breath puff (client-only).
recipes.mut: `ABL_067` Freeze Touch (`MUT_176` Frost Fingers) skips the freezer; `MUT_131` Fridge Body and `MUT_162` Ice Crystal Arm (ice) cut freeze time.

recipes.name: Rainbow Burger
recipes.desc: Seven colours, one burger, zero restraint. The Influencer has photographed this 4,000 times and eaten it twice.
steps: Slice ING_TOMATO, shred ING_LETTUCE and ING_PURPLE_CABBAGE.
Swirl ING_MAYO then ING_RAINBOW_SYRUP into Rainbow Mayo (don't over-mix the bands).
ING_BUN heel, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_TOMATO red, ING_CHEESE yellow, ING_LETTUCE green, ING_PURPLE_CABBAGE violet, ING_RAINBOW_SYRUP mayo with ING_MAYO, ING_SPRINKLES, ING_BUN crown.
Plate on the white plate so the colours pop.
cx: The rainbow is out of order. Red goes FIRST.
Where's indigo? Nobody ever remembers indigo.
recipes.look: Burger with visibly separated colour bands in each layer and a sprinkle-dusted crown; a faint rainbow arc hovers above it.
recipes.anim: Influencer-type customers play a camera-pose before ANM_043 (uses ANM_042 Order wave held as a selfie pose).
recipes.vfx: Short rainbow arc decal over the plate (client-only, 2 s) and sparkle bursts.
recipes.mut: `MUT_270` Rainbow Holo Scales (glow) add a free shimmer to the plate; plant-tagged parts (`MUT_093` Leaf Ears) widen the chop zone for all three veg.

recipes.name: Mystery Meat Burger
recipes.desc: What's in the Mystery Meat? The label says '?'. The supplier says '?'. Professor Saucington says 'it's beef' and then winks for nine seconds.
steps: Grill ING_MYSTERY_MEAT; it flips itself if you wait (don't wait).
Char ING_ONION slices on the other slot (no flip).
Mystery Sauce: ING_KETCHUP, then ING_MUSTARD, then ING_MAYO.
ING_BUN heel, ING_MYSTERY_MEAT, ING_CHEESE, ING_ONION, ING_PICKLE, ING_KETCHUP sauce blend with ING_MUSTARD and ING_MAYO, ING_BUN crown.
Plate under a cloche; lift it dramatically.
cx: I solved the mystery and I'm disappointed. It's beef.
Was it supposed to wink at me?
recipes.look: Grey-brown patty stamped with a glowing '?' brand, under a little silver cloche.
recipes.anim: Cloche-lift flourish on PLATE (ANM_018); the '?' brand blinks once (decal flipbook).
recipes.vfx: Puff of purple question-mark particles when the cloche lifts.
recipes.mut: `ABL_064` Super Sniff (`MUT_058`) 'reveals' the secret: it is beef (joke reveal). `MUT_050` Pig Snout chefs earn a suspicious side-eye from the patty.

recipes.name: Tentacle Burger
recipes.desc: Two grilled squishy tentacles curl out of the bun and wave politely at passing customers. Tartar sauce keeps them calm.
steps: Grill both ING_TENTACLE; flip as they curl.
ING_BUN heel, ING_TARTAR_SAUCE, ING_TENTACLE pair curling outward, ING_CHEESE, ING_TOMATO, ING_LETTUCE, ING_BUN crown.
Plate with both tentacles waving toward the customer.
cx: It waved at me. I didn't wave back. Now it's awkward.
Only two tentacles? My cousin has eight.
recipes.look: Purple tentacles with cute suckers curl out of both sides of a sesame bun like a hug.
recipes.anim: Tentacle tips wave in a slow loop (prop bones) and curl shut when bitten.
recipes.vfx: Tiny bubble particles from the suckers; a 'hi!' text bubble on serve.
recipes.mut: Tentacle-tagged parts (`MUT_145` Octopus Arm, `MUT_146` Squid Tentacle Arm) build two layers per input; Sea Legs adds burn grace; customers wearing `MUT_137` Kraken Core give a knowing nod.

recipes.name: Exploding Burger
recipes.desc: Kaboom Crystals in the ketchup make every bite pop with harmless crackles and a confetti burst. Customers flinch, then order another.
steps: Slice ING_PICKLE; cut ING_ONION into a long 'fuse' strip.
Kaboom Ketchup: ING_KETCHUP first, ING_KABOOM_CRYSTALS last (or they pop early).
ING_BUN heel, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_CHEESE, ING_KETCHUP kaboom sauce with ING_KABOOM_CRYSTALS, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_CHEESE, ING_PICKLE, ING_BUN crown, ING_ONION fuse on top.
Plate with the fuse pointing up; never point it at a Nervous Newt.
cx: It didn't explode. I want a refund of my excitement.
It exploded RIGHT AWAY. I wasn't READY.
recipes.look: Double burger with a crispy onion 'fuse' sticking out of the crown and red-speckled crackling sauce.
recipes.anim: On the customer's first ANM_043 bite the burger 'pops': bun lifts 0.5 studs and lands back (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Kid-safe confetti burst and comic 'POP!' text; small cartoon smoke puff, no fire.
recipes.mut: `ABL_066` Zap-Cook finishes the patties instantly but the crystals still need the MIX; `MUT_068` Megaphone Mouth (loud) makes the POP louder (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Upside-Down Burger
recipes.desc: Built crown-first, served heel-up, eaten by customers who insist gravity is 'just a suggestion'. Comes with a fried egg on the bottom, which is now the top.
steps: Shred ING_LETTUCE; slice ING_TOMATO, ING_AVOCADO and ING_ONION.
Toast the ING_BUN halves face-down (no flip).
Fry ING_BACON and ING_EGG together in one basket; shake once.
Upside down: ING_BUN crown, ING_KETCHUP, ING_EGG, ING_BACON, ING_AVOCADO, ING_ONION, ING_TOMATO, ING_LETTUCE, ING_CHEESE, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_BUN heel.
Plate it exactly as built — do NOT flip it 'right'.
cx: This is right-side up. You flipped it. I can TELL.
The egg should be looking at the ceiling.
recipes.look: Burger with the domed crown at the bottom (resting in a little ring stand) and the flat heel on top, fried egg peeking out underneath.
recipes.anim: Customer tilts head 180° (neck morph) before ANM_043; the burger rocks on its dome.
recipes.vfx: A tiny 'gravity optional' swirl glyph spins above the plate for 1.5 s.
recipes.mut: Many Hands builds the reversed stack faster; `ABL_069` Hover Serve (`MUT_245` Jetpack) carries it inverted with no topple risk.

recipes.name: Invisible Burger
recipes.desc: A patty infused with Invisi-Mist so it can't be seen, only tasted. Customers pay full price for a bun that seems to be floating. Trust the process.
steps: Infuse the grilled ING_BEEF_PATTY with ING_INVISI_MIST; hold pressure 50–75 until it fades from view.
ING_BUN heel, ING_BEEF_PATTY (invisible), ING_CHEESE, ING_TOMATO, ING_LETTUCE, ING_KETCHUP, ING_BUN crown.
Plate it; the ghost outline guide shows where the patty is.
cx: I can still see a faint shimmer. Do it again.
How do I know there's a patty? Because I paid for it?
recipes.look: Bun, cheese and veggies floating with a perfectly patty-shaped gap; a faint shimmer outlines the invisible patty.
recipes.anim: Customer pokes the gap (finger tap anim on ANM_043 lead-in) and reacts with a double-take.
recipes.vfx: Shimmer distortion ring (client-only; Reduced Effects shows a dotted outline instead).
recipes.mut: `MUT_252` Ghost Sheet Cape chefs see the patty outline clearly; `ABL_070` Eagle Eye highlights it on the plate; Space Chef widens the INFUSE window.

recipes.name: The Unreasonably Large Burger
recipes.desc: Eight patties, eight cheeses, six bacon strips and a bun the size of a beanbag chair. Health inspectors measure it in floors.
steps: Bake ING_GIANT_BUN on HIGH; it barely fits.
Shred ING_LETTUCE; slice ING_TOMATO, ING_ONION and ING_PICKLE.
Rounds 3–4: grill the last four ING_BEEF_PATTY.
ING_GIANT_BUN heel, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_CHEESE, ING_BACON, ING_PICKLE, ING_ONION, ING_TOMATO, ING_LETTUCE, ING_KETCHUP, ING_MUSTARD, ING_GIANT_BUN crown (each patty+cheese pair repeats ×8).
Plate on the serving platter; two-handed carry recommended.
cx: It's only REASONABLY large.
I can't see the people on the other side of the table.
recipes.look: A burger 3 studs tall on a platter, flags on toothpicks at every second patty, cheese cascading like a waterfall.
recipes.anim: Carrier uses ANM_007 Carry tray with an overloaded wobble; the customer climbs onto the chair to reach the top (ANM_040 variant).
recipes.vfx: Ground-shake dust puff when the platter lands; comic 'THUD' text.
recipes.mut: Carry-boosting parts (`MUT_249` Extra Arm Backpack, `MUT_217` Monkey Tail) make the platter one-hand carryable; heavy-tagged `MUT_148` Gorilla Arm earns a 'lift with your legs' bark.
